queries_run: FIX Comfort Systems USA analyst price target consensus 2026
FIX Comfort Systems USA guidance raise OR cut 2026 Q2 earnings
Comfort Systems USA FIX price target raised August 2026 analyst

findings.claim: 分析師共識評等為「Strong Buy」，平均目標價約 $2,197（8–10 位分析師，區間 $1,910–$2,500，中位數約 $2,166），對比 numbers.price_at_dd（$1,610.34）隱含約 30–39% 上檔空間
findings.source: stockanalysis.com — Comfort Systems USA (FIX) Stock Forecast & Analyst Price Targets (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fix/forecast/); 同期 investing.com consensus estimates 頁面交叉確認

findings.claim: 2026 年 Q2（calendar Q2）財報：營收 $3.27B（YoY +50%，首次單季破 $30 億），EPS $12.53，淨利年增 91% 至 $441.6M；管理層將全年同店營收成長 guidance 上修至「中至高 30% 區間」（先前為中至高 20% 區間）
findings.source: Yahoo Finance — Comfort Systems USA Inc (FIX) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Highlights (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/comfort-systems-usa-inc-fix-230035794.html); TIKR blog — Comfort Systems' Q2 Earnings Crossed $3 Billion (https://www.tikr.com/blog/comfort-systems-q2-earnings-crossed-3-billion-for-the-first-time-the-backlog-says-more-is-coming)

findings.claim: 在制文件中積壓訂單（backlog）於 Q2 2026 季底達歷史新高 $14.1B，年增 73%、季增 13%，其中 $5.6B 的年增來自既有業務（非併購貢獻）
findings.source: Investing.com — Comfort Systems Q2 2026 slides: revenue tops $3B, backlog hits $14B (https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/comfort-systems-q2-2026-slides-revenue-tops-3b-backlog-hits-14b-93CH-4812234)

findings.claim: 多家券商於 Q2 財報後上修目標價：UBS 由 $2,125 上調至 $2,225；KeyBanc 由 $2,004 上調至 $2,110（理由為上修營收/獲利估計）；Goldman Sachs 以 Buy 評等、$2,159 目標價新啟動覆蓋
findings.source: Benzinga analyst ratings aggregation for FIX (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/FIX/analyst-ratings); WallStreetZen FIX stock forecast (https://www.wallstreetzen.com/stocks/us/nyse/fix/stock-forecast)

findings.claim: 管理層在 Q2 法說會中提示下半年（尤其 Q4）成長將因比較基期轉難而放緩，市場對「沒有進一步加速」的訊號有失望反應
findings.source: TIKR blog — Comfort Systems' Q2 Earnings Crossed $3 Billion for the First Time (https://www.tikr.com/blog/comfort-systems-q2-earnings-crossed-3-billion-for-the-first-time-the-backlog-says-more-is-coming)
